0022600191.text: The Knicks (4-4, winners of their last two) visit the Cavaliers (4-4, losers of their last two) in the ninth game of New York's season, with New York seventh in the East and Cleveland sixth. New York is without Josh Hart, who is out with an ankle injury, while Cleveland is missing Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), and Sam Merrill (elbow). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and swept the Cavaliers 4-0 in the 2025-26 playoffs, most recently winning 130-93 in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
